windows.name: mod1440_records_gv
windows._note: Germany on 24 November 1939, the day the build comes to the user's save: party support back-filled from National Figures' series 30 (the months before November 1939 hold the ruling party only), Heidegger and Mueller without a picture (decision 2), every chief and member a general or an admiral, six upgrades done.

mod1440_records_gv.gv_since: Kept since 30 September, 1944  -  1374 days on record
mod1440_records_gv.gv_pt_2_name: Kommunistische Partei Deutschlands - Kommunistische Partei Opposition
mod1440_records_gv.gv_legend_bf: §gBefore 1 November, 1939 the record kept the ruling party only (National Figures, series 30).§!

manual: Several years of play with a change of ruling party and an election (the chart's band and tick, the heads panel's terms); the user's own save of 24 November 1939 for the back-fill
checklist: The page in the steel look: seven steel cards (Head of government 540x446 and Party support 1106x446 on top, Cabinet 540x280, Faction and subjects 540x352, High command 540x376, In the War Diary 540x256, Intelligence 560x638), 6 apart; the window's ground, title strip and tabs unchanged

Head of government: name in hoi_24header, the flag, party and ideology, the portrait at full size (a head with no portrait the game can name: the flag on the dark inset with the group's icon); the banded table of eight rows: Party / In office / On record / Last election / Next election against the politics panel, Party support against its pie, Stability and War support against the top bar. Fix round 1: no Traits strip (the head of government's traits are not shown)

Fix round 1, the crash: open the Records on the user's save of 24 August 1940 (Road to 56) and click every tab and the Heads of government button: no crash; error.log has no 'Invalid trait ... mod1440_records.txt' and no 'Not a valid value ... mod1440_records.txt' line (the operatives' mission quiet_network is accepted)
Laws in force: each kind with the law's own picture at 22x22 and its name, as the politics panel's law slots

Party support, the table: the four parties sorted by support, the ruling party on the lighter plate, Now as the politics panel's pie (hover it), Year a dash until twelve months are recorded; the results bar above it in the parties' colours, largest first, its lengths as the shares (hover each colour)

The chart, 5 years on the user's save of 24 November 1939 (or a save of the build before, one day played with this build): the ruling party's dots back to January 1936 from National Figures' series 30 (compare the dots' heights with National Figures' graph of 'Ruling party popularity'), the other three only from the first month with this build; the legend 'Before ... the record kept the ruling party only'

Effect mod1440_chk_gv_months (tools/check_effects.py): made-up months of party support over six years with a change of ruling party and an election; open the page: dots in the parties' colours (democratic blue 70,90,255, fascist brown 160,85,15 on the chart), the ruling party's dots on top, the shares at the lines' ends pushed apart, the years under the plot, the band in the ruling group's colour with the head's name where it fits (hover: name and dates), a white tick at the election; click 2 years, 5 years, 10 years: each redraws at once (the dots move by their y property in list rows: are they at their heights?), the chosen button gold; no stutter while the page is open (fifteen grids of up to 120 dots)

Heads of government (the button in the Head of government card, frame 2 while open): the panel over Party support, newest first, today's head on the lighter plate, In office with days, Stability and War support 'from to' (compare today's head's second number with the top bar's stability and war support), 'not recorded' for terms before the build, Elections per term; Party support (or the button again) goes back to the chart; effect mod1440_chk_gv_leader: a new row the next day

Cabinet: five seats of 48, each with portrait, name in yellow, role and 'since'; Heidegger and Mueller (Road to 56) with the unknown leader outline on the dark inset, its tooltip 'No picture...'; hover a name: the role and its effects with the game's names and values (compare with the advisor's own tooltip in the politics panel; Heidegger: Research Speed +5.00%, Daily Fascism Support +0.03, Construction Speed +2.50%)

The German Reich seat is gone: '5 in office' on the user's save (persons only); effect mod1440_chk_gv_phantom logs every element of political_advisor ('MOD1440 gv phantom: ...'): write down what the country element is (its number, name, whether it is ROOT); error.log has no 'is_character: Invalid Scope' line in mod1440_p_adv_political_advisor_GER after a day
Hire and dismiss (mod1440_chk_gv_hire, a day, then mod1440_chk_gv_fire, a day): the seat fills with his portrait, role and date, the War Diary card gets 'Appointed' and 'Left office' lines at its top

High command: seven rows of 48, the four offices then the members; the game's face of each general or admiral (34x46); a vacant office shows the politics panel's own empty slot picture and 'vacant'; hover: the chief's trait and its effects
In the War Diary: the government's eight newest lines (date, icon, words, person); All its lines opens the War Diary on the Government filter
Faction and subjects: the faction's name, led by, member flags (four to a row, scrolls), Subjects with the overlord or 'none' (mod1440_chk_puppet: Denmark as a tile)

Intelligence (mod1440_chk_gv_agency: an agency, two upgrades, an operative): the agency's name and 'founded <date>'; the 21 upgrade pictures, lit at their highest level and dimmed otherwise (compare with the agency's upgrade window; has_done_agency_upgrade of an upgrade with levels is true only at the highest); 'N of 21 at their highest level'

Operatives: a row per operative with the game's face (image = portrait in a list row with change_scope over the game's operatives array: is it his face, as in the agency's operatives view?), name, code name, the mission's own icon and title, the flag and state of his operation and 'network N%' (compare with the map's intel network coverage of that country); 'at home' for counter-intelligence at home; 'not assigned' without a mission

Cryptology: 'department active' or 'no department'; Our cipher strength and Cryptology defence level against the agency view (agency_crypto_defense_level, agency_decrypt_strength); Decrypting: the country and its progress against the cryptology tab's bar; Ciphers broken: the War Diary's cipher lines
What we know of: the enemies at war first, then the majors; Civilian, Army, Navy and Air against the intelligence ledger's values for each (write down whether they read as percent)

The @<country> forms with a country held in a variable (network_national_coverage@var:, decryption_progress@var:, *_intel@var:): error.log has no line about them after a daily round, and the numbers are not 0 where the game shows some (else the fallback of build.json)

error.log: no line that names the mod, no 'Could not find sprite type' (GFX_1440p_GV_*, GFX_1440p_SG_face_none_46x47, GFX_1440p_SG_dim_44, GFX_idea_slot_*), no unknown trigger or effect has_done_agency_upgrade (or an 'Invalid' line naming an upgrade, an idea or a mission), is_cryptology_department_active, is_decrypting, operative_leader_mission, is_major, every_operative, is_subject
